error_message: Mandatory field is missing or invalid

error.errorMessage: Mandatory field is missing or invalid. For field library, valid options are: Valid library code.

context.issue: Library code validation error in representation creation
context.explanation: The library code must match an actual Alma library code from configuration. Common mistake: copying from MARC 914 field which may contain batch identifiers or collection suffixes (e.g., 'LGBTQ-NLI-2') instead of the base library code ('LGBTQ').
context.solution: Verify library codes via API: GET /almaws/v1/conf/libraries or via Alma UI: Configuration > General > Libraries. Use the exact 'code' field value, not descriptions or MARC field values.
